title: Neuroschema
description: Root schema for neuroimaging metadata. Supports two document types: dataset-level summaries and record-level (per-data-file) metadata. The core fields are stable; domain-specific fields live under the 'extensions' namespace.

schema_version.description: Version of the neuroschema specification (Semantic Versioning MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH).

doc_type.description: Discriminator: 'dataset' for study-level metadata, 'record' for per-file metadata.
